title: Why authoritative SYSTEM-H failed the NATQ-002 floor despite outperforming BM25

external_reads: frozen chunk table cs_v1_control, to resolve stored chunk_ids into the version_id and character offsets they already carried at index time

finding_1_the_binding_constraint_is_rank.claim: The gap to the floor is a ranking loss, not a candidate-generation loss.

counterfactual_bound.caveat: This is an oracle bound on the stored pool, not a prediction. It says the evidence needed to clear the floor was already retrieved and then ranked away; it does not say any particular change would achieve it.

finding_2_the_cross_encoder_is_the_locus.claim: The cross-encoder scores correct evidence confidently low, and that is where the 12 spans are lost.

one_span_implicates_the_blend_not_the_CE.reading: A span the CE placed 7th in its pool still finished outside the top 10, so the EXP-017/EXP-019A blend demoted it. That is 1 of 12; the other 11 were already far down the CE ordering.

finding_2_the_cross_encoder_is_the_locus.limitation: CE-score rank is derived by ordering the stored CE scores. The pre-CE RRF rank was never persisted, so per-span reranker MOVEMENT (before minus after) cannot be computed from these traces and is reported as unavailable rather than estimated.

finding_3_candidate_generation_caps_at_0.claim: Candidate generation is not the immediate blocker but leaves almost no margin.
finding_3_candidate_generation_caps_at_0.reading: A perfect reranker over the pool as generated reaches 33/40 = 0.825, one case above the 0.80 floor. Any future configuration that improves ranking without improving candidate generation is working inside a 0.825 cap.

finding_4_the_projection_stage_contribut.claim: On NATQ-002 validation the projection stage supplied no gold coverage while occupying top-10 slots.
finding_4_the_projection_stage_contribut.what_this_does_and_does_not_establish: It establishes that 800 projection candidates covered zero gold spans, and that 12 of the 400 top-10 slots went to projection chunks that covered no gold span. It does NOT establish that removing the stage would raise case_hit@10 — that requires a counterfactual ranking this analysis is not authorised to produce.

taxonomy_notes.A_vs_E_note: GLOBAL_CANDIDATE_FAILURE and DOCUMENT_DISCOVERY_FAILURE are not separable from these traces; SYSTEM-A membership was not persisted apart from local BM25. Cases whose gold document never appears in the union pool are reported as E.

population_reading.H_RESCUES: 11 cases SYSTEM-H hits that BM25 misses — the reranker is doing real work.
population_reading.H_REGRESSIONS: 3 cases BM25 hits that SYSTEM-H misses (B09, B28, D27). All three are C_RERANKING_FAILURE: the covering candidate was in SYSTEM-H's pool and was ranked out. BM25 found the same evidence and kept it in its top 10.
population_reading.BOTH_MISS: 14 cases. 7 are B_LOCALIZATION_FAILURE, 5 are C_RERANKING_FAILURE, 2 are F_MIXED. So even inside the hardest population, a third are ranking losses rather than retrieval losses.

answer_to_the_question: SYSTEM-H outperformed BM25 because its reranking stage genuinely recovers evidence BM25 cannot surface: 11 rescued cases and a significant paired micro-MRR gain. It nonetheless missed the absolute floor because the same reranking stage discards evidence it already holds. 44 of 57 gold spans were retrieved into the final candidate pool and 12 of them were ranked out, taking 10 cases from hit to miss. Had those 10 held, case_hit@10 would have been 0.825 and above the PASS floor. The failure is therefore located in ranking, and within ranking primarily in the cross-encoder, which scored 11 of those 12 spans negative with a median score of -3.36 against +1.29 for spans that survived. Candidate generation is a secondary constraint that caps the system at 0.825 with only one case of margin.

instruction_completeness.truncated_at: RERANKER MOVEMENT — the bullet list ends mid-item at 'pre-CE rank / CE'
instruction_completeness.handling: Every fully specified section was completed. The reranker-movement section was answered as far as the stored traces allow, and its central requirement — pre-CE rank — is unavailable because RRF rank was never persisted. Any further sections after RERANKER MOVEMENT were not received and are not addressed.
